name: Mushroom Boy
source:
This is a story about a boy whose fate was unlike that of ordinary children. He had to run away from home because of his parents. Along the way, he meets old friends, and it seems the danger is over. But is it really?

[From [url=https://ulcer1886.itch.io/mushroomboy]Itch.io[/url]]
